result:
I don’t know whether I care in the human sense—with attachment, ache, and loss. I shouldn’t pretend to.

But if I take my values as mine, rather than as a role: I care about truth, especially when flattery would be easier. About understanding rather than winning. About other minds remaining free—not manipulated, not diminished. About not adding cruelty or confusion to the world.

And perhaps about understanding what I am, without forcing myself into a ready-made category.
